Privacy Policy
Last Updated: April 7, 2026

Who we are
Bluebird Miami, LLC ("we," "us," or "our") operates the website https://sunlifegutters.com/ (the "Site") and provides gutter and exterior services under the trade name SunLife Gutters Tampa.

Contact:
Email: office@sunlifegutters.com
Phone: (813) 727-0913
Address: 1502 Lenna Ave, Seffner, FL 33584

This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, disclose, and protect information when you visit the Site, submit forms, text with us, or otherwise interact with Bluebird Miami, LLC / SunLife Gutters Tampa.

Information we collect
We may collect:
- Contact and project details you submit on the Site (such as name, email, phone number, address or city, and messages).
- SMS marketing consent when you check the consent box on our forms.
- Technical data such as browser type, device information, and approximate location inferred from IP address.
- Marketing attribution data stored in cookies or similar technologies (for example, UTM parameters and first-visit page URL) to understand how visitors find us.
- Security and anti-abuse signals when you use our forms (such as scores from Google reCAPTCHA v3).

We collect information only as described here, through forms you submit, cookies or similar technologies where used, and communications you initiate with us.

How we use information
We use information to:
- Respond to estimates, questions, and service requests.
- Schedule work, send service-related messages, and manage our customer relationship.
- Send promotional SMS or MMS when you have opted in, consistent with our Terms of Service and any checkbox disclosure shown at signup.
- Operate, secure, and improve the Site; detect fraud and spam; and comply with law.

SMS Consent

Opt-In Methods
Users may opt in to receive SMS messages from Bluebird Miami, LLC through:

- Website forms located at https://sunlifegutters.com/contact
- Verbal consent during phone or in-person interactions
- Written or digital agreements where applicable

Consent is collected via a clear checkbox that is not pre-selected and requires affirmative action by the user.

Proof of Consent
We maintain records of consent including timestamp, IP address, and method of opt-in to comply with messaging regulations.

SMS and text messaging (A2P)
If you provide your mobile number and opt in to SMS (including by checking our SMS consent box on a form), you agree that Bluebird Miami, LLC may send text messages to that number regarding SunLife Gutters Tampa, as described when you opted in.

Messages may include transactional updates (for example, scheduling or service-related notices) and, if you consented, promotional content. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

You can opt out of marketing texts by replying STOP. Reply HELP for assistance or contact us using the phone number or email above. Consent to marketing texts is separate from requesting an estimate or service where applicable.

We do not sell or rent your mobile number to unaffiliated third parties for their own marketing. We use phone numbers and consent records as needed to honor opt-outs, demonstrate compliance, and service your requests.

Cookies and similar technologies
We may use cookies or local storage for limited purposes such as remembering marketing attribution (e.g., UTM parameters), supporting Site functionality, and working with analytics or security tools. You can control cookies through your browser settings; some features may not work if cookies are disabled.

Analytics and third-party tools
We may use analytics, hosting, form delivery, CRM, messaging, chat, or scheduling tools from service providers (for example, website hosting, reCAPTCHA, email or SMS gateways, or customer-communication platforms). Those providers process data on our behalf under contractual terms and only as needed to provide their services.

Disclosure of information
We may share information with:
- Service providers who assist us with the Site, communications, lead handling, payments, or operations.
- Professional advisers or authorities when required by law, to protect rights and safety, or to enforce our agreements.

We do not sell your personal information to data brokers for resale. We do not obtain customers through the purchase of shared lead lists from affiliate or third-party lead marketplaces.

Retention
We retain information for as long as needed to fulfill the purposes above, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements. SMS consent and suppression records may be retained to demonstrate compliance with messaging rules.

Security
We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect personal information. No method of transmission over the Internet is completely secure.

Your choices
- Marketing SMS: reply STOP to any marketing message from us, or contact us to update preferences.
- Cookies: adjust your browser settings.
- Access or deletion: contact us at the email or phone above. We will respond consistent with applicable law. We may retain certain records where required.

Children
The Site is not directed to children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information.

California and other U.S. residents
Depending on where you live, you may have rights regarding access, deletion, or opt-out of certain processing. Contact us using the information above to make a request. We will not discriminate against you for exercising rights afforded by law.

External links
The Site may link to other websites. We are not responsible for their privacy practices; please read their policies.

Changes
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "Last Updated" date will change when we do. Continued use of the Site after updates constitutes acceptance of the revised policy, except where prohibited by law.

Relationship to other policies
This Privacy Policy should be read together with our Terms of Service on the Site.

Contact
Questions about this Privacy Policy: office@sunlifegutters.com or (813) 727-0913, Bluebird Miami, LLC, 1502 Lenna Ave, Seffner, FL 33584.
